issues.on_page: Other Local Receipts remainder 26,967 = General 6,110 (1911 Local License Fees 3,735 + 1925 Categorical Grants 1,750 + 1960 Misc Revenues From Other Local Government Units 625, p9) + Special Building 20,857 (p17, undescribed)
issues.issue: The review note says the remainder has no description, but the General Fund's 6,110 part is itemized on p9. Keeping 'other' is defensible because the undescribed 20,857 is 77% of the line. It could be split instead (split_from p9/p17) into licenses and permits 3,735, donations/contributions 1,750, state aid/other local 625 and other 20,857.
